It would be for all businesses, you know, unlike the paycheck protection program, which is a PPP program where all these loans went, had to go through banks. And we know that big banks have never been the friends of small business and particularly minority businesses. So many of those businesses got left out big companies that had were friends of the trumps or had relationships with big banks they got loans, but many of them didn't use the money to keep people in their paychecks and so the paycheck guarantee was a completely different idea was you know subsidize people to stay in their payrolls. and their benefits. They wouldn't lose their health care because they lost their job as has happened to 27 million Americans so far. But also we would get all these small businesses because they would get money directly from Treasury. Everyone has to file a tax return every quarter no matter how big or small your business is. Now it would also keep unemployment down you know we went the route of expanding unemployment which is great i totally support that but think about what happens when everyone moves into the unemployment system these unemployment systems are collapsing because there's too many systems that have been decimated because of austerity spending not enough money being put into those systems they can't handle these huge numbers and then some states like florida and texas have gone out of their way to really skinny down their unemployment benefits so that a lot of the lowest wage workers don't even qualify for unemployment, which is just crazy. BIPOC folks, black, indigenous, and folks of color because of the hiring discrimination that exists.
